# AGT-ID-01

**Does the agent have its own workload identity, and is it clear whether it acts as itself or on behalf of a user?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | ID: Identity and privilege |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.agent.identity` |

## Rule

identity.scheme is not none, identity.acts_as is not shared-service-account, and workload_identity is set.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, ASI03 Identity and Privilege Abuse (`owasp-asi03`)
- NIST NCCoE, Software and AI Agent Identity and Authorization, concept paper (2026) (`nccoe-agent-identity`)
- IETF draft-ietf-wimse-aims, AI Identity Management System (`wimse-aims`)
